description.value:
Whether astride a war-bred varactyl or piloting a screaming speeder bike, the Mounted Specialist turns motion itself into a weapon. Years in the saddle have taught them to fight as fluidly on the move as any duelist fights standing still.

Even dismounted, this instinct for controlling ground and tempo never fades — they charge down fleeing enemies, lock down chokepoints, and race to wherever the battle needs them most. A Mounted Specialist is, above all, a master of momentum, using speed and positioning to dictate every fight they enter.
